title: Each point told once
text: (M-4) Each point told once. Drop retellings, off-topic asides, backstory and feelings that don't move events (shorten as much as possible). Law stays only as the answer to the guest's own case: right after the fact it explains, or as the verdict, often near the end once the story is told; never a lecture (HKS-C8, 2026-11-24).

source.heading: Cut rules for the long form (step 3)

confirm: Which retellings, asides and backstory were dropped, and where (timecode) does law appear as the answer to a guest's own case?
